user.title: Neil Connect
user.description: Select a Neil climatizador. Disconnect the official app first (only one phone can hold the BLE connection). On first setup, power the remote off and hold + and − for 5 seconds until the Bluetooth icon blinks.

service_due.title: {name}: preventive maintenance due
service_due.description:
{name} has reached 300 hours of use. Do this preventive maintenance, page 11 of the manual:

1. Remove the white shell by taking out the screws on its sides.
2. The spray tube, on the back of the shell, must have every orifice clear. Clean with compressed air from the T that joins the two sections.
3. Remove the evaporator filter and wash it with plenty of water (no chemicals).
4. Remove the pre-cooling chamber cover (held by screws) and clean the sensors and the humidifier pump filter, or replace that filter.
5. Check the humidifier pump. Turn the unit on with the fan at minimum speed, turn on pre-cooling (button 10), and confirm the water from the humidification hose fills a coffee cup. If the flow is lower, replace the pump with a new one of the same voltage.
6. Put every part back in its original place.

Before leaving the unit unused for a long time, run it for 3 hours with pre-cooling off so the evaporator filter dries.

Then press Reset maintenance.

Manual: https://github.com/gvillo/ha-neil-connect/blob/main/manuals/Manual-de-Uso-e-Instalacion-Linea-Slim-_ARG_V02-Connect.pdf
Maintenance: https://neil.com.ar/soporte-tecnico/mantenimiento/

filter_due.title: {name}: evaporator filter replacement due
filter_due.description:
{name} has reached 900 hours of use. Do the preventive maintenance and replace the evaporator filter, page 11 of the manual:

1. Remove the white shell by taking out the screws on its sides.
2. The spray tube, on the back of the shell, must have every orifice clear. Clean with compressed air from the T that joins the two sections.
3. Remove the evaporator filter and replace it with a new one.
4. Remove the pre-cooling chamber cover (held by screws) and clean the sensors and the humidifier pump filter, or replace that filter.
5. Check the humidifier pump. Turn the unit on with the fan at minimum speed, turn on pre-cooling (button 10), and confirm the water from the humidification hose fills a coffee cup. If the flow is lower, replace the pump with a new one of the same voltage.
6. Put every part back in its original place.

Then press Reset filter replacement and maintenance.

Manual: https://github.com/gvillo/ha-neil-connect/blob/main/manuals/Manual-de-Uso-e-Instalacion-Linea-Slim-_ARG_V02-Connect.pdf
Maintenance: https://neil.com.ar/soporte-tecnico/mantenimiento/
